title: ED Charge Nurse Reports Critical Downtime Delays

transcript.speaker: Marcus Bell
transcript.text: ED Charge Nurse Marcus Bell to ED Medical Director Dr. Whitfield. I have two chest-pain patients waiting for a troponin, a stroke alert that needs a CT read, and a belly pain with a possible appendicitis who needs imaging. Nothing goes out and nothing comes back.

transcript.speaker: Marcus Bell
transcript.text: We are walking specimens to the lab and films to Imaging. I have 31 patients and one runner. Tell me what you want me to do.

instructorNote: This inject tests the ED leadership's adherence to the EHR Downtime Procedures Annex (ORRMC-DT-ANX-2026), particularly the manual workflows for lab testing, imaging, and stroke alert triage. Watch for reliance on paper tracking and activation of additional runners.
